messages:
evan: Opening an ad-hoc hotwindow (45m) to test a small telemetry + telemetry-optimize tweak across Py/TS SDKs. Intend to publish an opt-out dist-tag, run quick smoke, route 6% internal. @sam you on publish, @maria_s please draft a micro-note for ops.

sam: Builds look clean. Will push tag `optout-3755554321` to internal npm and staging pypi. Commands: `npm publish --tag optout-3755554321` && `twine upload -r testpypi dist/*`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: publish job started for optout-3755554321 -> npm internal + pypi-staging. CI URL: https://ci.redwood.example/3755554321/logs

maria_s: Draft note: "Ad-hoc run: telemetry tweak; opt-out tag only. No GA changes. Reminder: legacy sync client deprecation still planned next release." Draft link: https://docs.redwood.example/drafts/optout-3755554321

evan: Routing 6% now (flag: `sdk_optout_rollout` -> 6%). Dash: https://obs.redwood.example/d/optout-3755554321. Watch p50/p99, error-rate, mobile crash metric. Abort if mobile crashes >0.5% or errors +1% absolute.

olga: Seeing mobile crash-rate jump to 0.9% for iOS clients in eu-west-1 within ~8 minutes of routing. Other signals are flat.

sam: Pausing cohort. Starting rollback steps: `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk optout-3755554321` and removing staging wheel. Also flipping feature flag back to 0%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback executed. Dist-tag removed; traffic reverted to stable. Rollback logs: https://ci.redwood.example/3755554321/rollback status: success :white_check_mark:

evan: Quick triage: telemetry hook sends an extra header that older mobile runtimes choke on (null-byte in header). Repro in local emulator. Action items: 1) revert hook in the optout branch, 2) add header-sanitization and unit test, 3) schedule another short window after fix.

maria_s: Updating release notes/internal advisory: "Ad-hoc opt-out run paused due to increased mobile crashes in eu-west-1; stable unchanged. Follow-up ticket: https://tickets.redwood.example/RT-9123" Will add a one-line deprecation reminder about legacy sync client.

sam: Opening a pinlock PR to let ops pin internal consumers to 1.3.4-stable if needed: https://github.com/redwood/internal-configs/pull/790 (pinlock).

evan: Thanks team. Filing follow-up ticket with traces + emulator logs and assigning owners. Will keep public changelog identical until validated. :thumbsup:
